description: Curated broad HTS-prefix research prompts; NOT ACE PGA flags, HTS-to-PGA legal mappings, agency clearance or exhaustive coverage.

signals.label: Food & agricultural products
signals.rationale: Product identity, processing and intended use determine which food, agriculture or animal requirements apply.

signals.label: Pharmaceuticals / medicinal preparations
signals.rationale: Investigate drug/device classification, intended use and regulatory status.

signals.label: Cosmetics and personal care preparations
signals.rationale: Composition and intended use determine FDA and/or chemical regulatory scope.

signals.label: Medical instruments and devices
signals.rationale: Device intended use and classification matter; HTS heading alone is not determinative.

signals.label: Chemicals and chemical preparations
signals.rationale: Substance/mixture/article distinctions, CAS identities, and regulatory exclusions matter.

signals.label: Pesticides and disinfectants
signals.rationale: Investigate FIFRA pesticide registration and relevant TSCA rules.

signals.label: Wood and wood articles
signals.rationale: Plant species, product scope, declaration phase-in and exceptions must be verified.

signals.label: Paper, pulp and printed products
signals.rationale: Lacey declaration scope varies by product and implementation phase.

signals.label: Furniture and wood components
signals.rationale: Determine whether regulated plant materials are present and declaration requirements apply.

signals.label: Vehicles and engines
signals.rationale: Vehicle/engine emissions rules may require separate import evidence.

signals.label: Battery and electrical energy storage
signals.rationale: Screen chemical form, battery composition and potential EPA rules; ordinary battery articles are not automatically TSCA certification-required.

signals.label: Textile or leather materials
signals.rationale: Animal/wildlife or protected species questions may arise depending on exact material and species.
